theme.concept: Midnight Acoustic & Studio Light - A sophisticated, high-contrast palette mixing Instagram's layout, Spotify's darkness, and Airbnb's usability.

rules: Use 'Outfit' for all headings (H1-H6). It provides a geometric, modern, and rhythmic aesthetic perfect for a music platform.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text, inputs, and UI elements for maximum legibility.
Never use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Arial.
Headings larger than 32px MUST use tight letter spacing (letter-spacing: -0.02em).

layouts.app_shell: Desktop: Fixed Left Sidebar (280px), Center Feed Column (max-width: 600px), Right Explore Panel (320px). Mobile: Bottom tab navigation.
layouts.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical bento grids for the 'Explorar' section. Combine tall cards (row-span-2) with standard square cards.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use CSS variables for generous spacing: --space-sm (8px), --space-md (16px), --space-lg (32px), --space-xl (64px).

component_styles.buttons: Pill-shaped (border-radius: 9999px). Primary buttons use var(--color-primary). Add 'transform: translateY(-2px)' and subtle box-shadow on hover.
component_styles.feed_cards: Flat surfaces with var(--bg-surface) and 1px var(--border-subtle). Do not over-shadow. Images bleed to the edges of the card container.
component_styles.sidebar: Fixed position. Includes Logo, User Profile snippet, and navigation links. Active link should have bold text and a primary color accent.
component_styles.profile_hero: Hero cover image height 30vh. Avatar overlaps the cover by 50% (margin-top: -60px), with a 4px solid border matching var(--bg-base) to create a cutout effect.
component_styles.modals_and_proposals: Centered in viewport. Glassmorphic backdrop overlay. The modal itself uses var(--bg-surface) with a 24px border-radius.
component_styles.glassmorphism: Used strictly for sticky headers, bottom nav, and modal backdrops. Requires 'backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%)' and a 1px semi-transparent border.

rules: Use micro-interactions for all interactive elements.
NEVER use 'transition: all'. Use specific properties: 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease'.
Add staggered fade-in animations for feed posts using CSS keyframes (@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }).

image_urls.description: Dramatic lighting at a live concert. Perfect for the Landing Page Hero or an event highlight in the feed.
Man playing electric guitar. Ideal for the 'Músico' profile hero cover.
Modern bar/pub interior. Perfect for the 'Estabelecimento' profile cover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a clean Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JS architecture. DO NOT use React, Vue, Tailwind, or Shadcn.
Create an 'index.html' holding the Landing Page, and separate HTML files or dynamically injected views via JS for the App interface (Feed, Profiles).
Use CSS Variables (:root and [data-theme='dark']) in 'style.css' to implement the dark/light mode logic.
Implement a theme toggle button that switches the 'data-theme' attribute on the document element.
Use Vanilla JS (app.js) to create mock data arrays and dynamically render the Instagram-style feed (posts, likes, comments).
Ensure layout is responsive: use media queries to hide the sidebar and show a bottom glassmorphic navigation bar on mobile screens.
Implement the 3 specific profiles (Músico, Estabelecimento, Ouvinte) with their respective CTAs ('Enviar Proposta', 'Contratar Banda').
All text content MUST be in Portuguese (pt-BR).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='theme-toggle-button').
Do not apply global text centering. Keep text left-aligned for natural reading, except in specific hero sections.
Hover states must have higher contrast or a clear visual shift.
CRITICAL: Never use completely transparent backgrounds for elements overlapping content (headers, dropdowns, modals). Always apply a blur and a semi-transparent color (glassmorphism).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
